name: Energy Monitor
description: Show generation, consumption and grid flow from Fronius or JSON. Choose watts or kilowatts, labels and precision.

displayName.title: Name in admin
displayName.description: Name this copy for its purpose, such as Lobby weather or Workshop energy. Its connection ID stays the same.

provider.title: Data source
provider.description: Choose where this copy gets its data. Sample data lets you try the display before connecting a service.

title.title: Display title
title.description: Default heading on the display. A screen panel can override it.

cacheMs.title: Response cache · milliseconds
cacheMs.description: How long server responses are reused. 0 bypasses this response cache; a provider may also have its own refresh interval.

timeoutMs.title: Request timeout · milliseconds
timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait for an upstream response before showing an unavailable state.

url.title: JSON endpoint
url.description: Endpoint returning the documented JSON data format for this plugin.

path.title: JSON file path
path.description: Path on the Castboard server, relative to its configuration folder. In Docker, this must be a mounted path.

headers.title: Request headers
headers.description: Optional request headers as a JSON object. Saved values are hidden and never sent to displays.

baseUrl.title: Inverter URL
baseUrl.description: Base address of the compatible service, reachable from the Castboard server.

compact.title: Compact layout
compact.description: Use the layout designed for small screens.

precision.title: Decimal places
precision.description: Decimal places shown for power values.

loadLabel.title: Usage label
loadLabel.description: For example Home load, Office usage or Site demand.

refreshSeconds.title: Check for updates · seconds
refreshSeconds.description: How often the display requests data. The response cache can reduce upstream requests.

displayNotes: Compact browser and image-mode panels use green upward arrows for generation and grid export, amber downward arrows for household consumption and grid import, and a neutral dash for idle or unknown flow. Labels accompany colour; native text views retain their existing readings.
